interview.name: Uli
interview.answer: The repair drive is on Sunday at the community center.

reflections: Leo is reliable and ready to take concrete ownership on the repair drive.
Uli is coordinating quietly and keeping others informed as needed.
Noah is catching up after missing part of the work and needs a concise status update.
Uli is coordinating the repair drive and delegates concrete tasks to others rather than doing everything alone.
Leo, Bo, and Mara are all willing to help when asked, with Mara taking on organization and sign-up tracking.
Noah is slightly out of the loop but engaged and receptive to updates about the ongoing effort.
Uli relies on a small, dependable group and consistently follows up with thanks, suggesting a collaborative, appreciative style.
Mara is organized and proactive in hands-on logistics, and Uli trusts her to take ownership of coordination tasks.
Oren and Bo are helpful but provide support mostly through updates and timing information, so Uli is managing multiple parallel dependencies while keeping communication calm and clear.
Uli is coordinating the repair drive and relying on a few people to keep logistics, supplies, and status checks moving.
The group responds cooperatively and promptly, with people taking on small, concrete follow-through tasks rather than broad commitments.
Rosa and Uli appear to be managing the central updates, while others help with timing, location, materials, and intake sorting.
Uli is the main coordinator, repeatedly confirming timing, location, and updates for the repair drive.
Cleo, Rosa, Mina, and Pia are supportive participants who depend on clear logistics and keep the group aligned.
The group values repeated confirmation of changes, suggesting the event details are moving and people want reassurance about the final plan.

events.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next task?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Could you help sort the donated parts and label what still needs fixing?
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll sort the donated parts and label anything that still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Uli: I’ve been keeping it moving, just quietly. I can give you the latest if you want—there’s a bit to sort through.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Noah: Yeah, please—catch me up. I might’ve missed a few things.

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Could you help sort the donated parts and label what still needs fixing?

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. That helps a lot.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Mara: I’ve got the clipboard and tape, and I can help keep the sign-ups organized. If you need anything else, just tell me where to start.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara. Could you start by setting up the sign-up sheet, and I’ll bring over the donated parts to sort?
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll set up the sign-up sheet now and keep things organized. Bring the donated parts over when you’re ready, and I’ll help track who signs up.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scatterbrained today, but I’ll check on it and let you know what I find.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’ll wait for your update.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll take a look and get back to you soon. If I find the drop-off spot, I’ll let you know that too.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Uli: We still need a hand with the intake table. If you’re free, could you help me sort the parts as they come in?
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Bo: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out for the timing and drop-off spot, and let you know as soon as I hear anything.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. That helps a lot.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo — that’d help a lot. I’m going to check what still needs to be fixed and see what’s missing.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ve still got the tape and screws set aside, and I’m sorting the spare tools. Just send me the time and address for the repair drive, and I’ll help point folks the right way.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll send the time and address shortly. I’m still checking the list, and I’ll let you know if we need anything else.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll check what still needs fixing and sort the donated parts next.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — that helps a lot. Please check Sunday at the community center, and let me know what’s still needed so I can keep everyone updated.
events.speaker: Rosa
